question: After the promise-forwarding defect is fixed, should Control UI adopt `/new --name <title>` as its create-time session naming command while other `/new <text>` forms remain anonymous?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and compatible with the existing label API, but accepting a Control UI-specific public slash-command grammar is a product and UX choice that source correctness cannot settle.

options.title: Adopt explicit `--name`
options.body: Merge the repaired PR with the narrow documented Control UI syntax and unchanged behavior for bare or arbitrary-text `/new` forms.

options.title: Use `/name` after creation
options.body: Decline create-time naming and keep the already shipped `/name <title>` command as the only chat naming workflow.

options.title: Unify shared `/new` grammar
options.body: Defer this PR and design one cross-surface named-session grammar together with the broader work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95700.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit `--name`
recommendation.body: Merge the repaired PR with the narrow documented Control UI syntax and unchanged behavior for bare or arbitrary-text `/new` forms.
